content.title: WHAT DOCTORS DON'T TELL YOU ABOUT THESE {{TINY}} DAILY HABITS
facts: Daily **1 clove raw garlic** – lower blood pressure
Daily **7 min walk after eating** – flattens sugar spike
Daily **20 min morning sunlight** – deeper sleep tonight
Daily **2 tbsp ground flaxseed** – smoother digestion
Daily **5 min box breathing** – calms your nerves
Daily **30 min screen-free before bed** – falls asleep faster
Daily **3 gratitude notes** – lowers stress hormone
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
A few of these are backed by more science than people realize. Garlic contains allicin, a sulfur compound that forms when it's crushed or chewed raw — it relaxes blood vessels and can measurably soften blood pressure within weeks. Flaxseed brings soluble fiber and lignans that slow down digestion, feed your gut bacteria, and help pull excess cholesterol out through your stool. And gratitude journaling isn't just a mood thing — writing down 3 specific things activates your prefrontal cortex and quiets the stress response, pulling your body out of fight-or-flight mode. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so notice what actually shifts for you.
